data.title: Mule Rapid ATM Withdrawal After Inbound Transfer
data.description: Detects cash withdrawals at ATMs occurring shortly after an inbound wire or ACH transfer. Money mules frequently convert electronically received fraud proceeds to cash as quickly as possible to prevent recovery, often hitting daily ATM limits across multiple machines.

queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Mule Rapid ATM Withdrawal After Inbound Transfer")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection_inbound | near selection_atm_withdrawal by account_id")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:transaction_monitoring
(event_type="WIRE_CREDIT" OR event_type="ACH_CREDIT")
transaction_amount>=2000
event_type="ATM_WITHDRAWAL"
transaction_amount>=500
| transaction account_id maxspan=4h
| where eventcount >= 2

falsepositives: Small business owners depositing and immediately withdrawing cash for operational expenses
Individuals receiving legitimate payroll via direct deposit and withdrawing cash
